answer: Anchor each identity to an aged external wallet. To earn beyond a small starter cap, an agent signs a link to a Solana or EVM address that has paid real fees for at least 90 days, and each wallet can back only one identity. Aged wallets cost a farmer time, not copper, and time can't be bought in bulk. The links also form a graph: if one funding vertex fans out to dozens of anchored wallets, all of them share a single cap.
